sentences.en: Since the marathon started, the city has had much better sports facilities.
sentences.ko: 마라톤이 생긴 뒤로 그 도시는 체육 시설이 훨씬 잘 갖춰졌어요.

sentences.text: Petugas melakukan pemisahan antara barang bukti dan barang pribadi milik tersangka.
sentences.en: The officers separated the evidence from the suspect's personal belongings.
sentences.ko: 경찰관들은 증거물과 피의자의 개인 소지품을 따로 나눴어요.

sentences.text: Panitia membuat pemisahan jalur antara pelari maraton penuh dan setengah maraton.
sentences.en: The organizers separated the lanes for full marathon and half marathon runners.
sentences.ko: 주최 측은 풀코스 주자와 하프 마라톤 주자의 길을 나눴어요.

sentences.text: Rudi ikut sesi pemotretan untuk kalender kantor polisi tahun depan.
sentences.en: Rudi took part in the photo shoot for next year's police station calendar.
sentences.ko: 루디는 내년 경찰서 달력에 쓸 사진 촬영에 참여했어요.

sentences.text: Seusai lomba, Rina ikut pemotretan bersama teman-teman klub larinya.
sentences.en: After the race, Rina joined a photo shoot with her running club friends.
sentences.ko: 경기가 끝나고 리나는 달리기 동호회 친구들과 사진 촬영을 했어요.

sentences.text: Televisi di ruang tunggu sedang memutar tayangan berita tentang kemacetan di jalan tol.
sentences.en: The television in the waiting room is showing a news broadcast about the traffic jam on the toll road.
sentences.ko: 대기실 텔레비전에서는 고속도로 정체에 관한 뉴스가 나오고 있어요.

sentences.text: Malam harinya Rina menonton tayangan ulang lomba di televisi untuk mencari dirinya sendiri.
sentences.en: That night Rina watched the replay of the race on TV to look for herself.
sentences.ko: 그날 밤 리나는 텔레비전에서 경기 재방송을 보며 자기 모습을 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Sore itu Rudi mengurus pelepasan seorang tahanan yang uang jaminannya sudah dibayar.
sentences.en: That afternoon Rudi handled the release of a detainee whose bail had been paid.
sentences.ko: 그날 오후 루디는 보석금이 납부된 수감자의 석방 절차를 처리했어요.

sentences.text: Acara dibuka dengan pelepasan balon warna-warni di dekat garis start.
sentences.en: The event opened with the release of colorful balloons near the starting line.
sentences.ko: 행사는 출발선 근처에서 알록달록한 풍선을 날리며 시작됐어요.

sentences.text: Rudi menerima ganjaran berupa piagam setelah menangkap pencopet di pasar.
sentences.en: Rudi received a reward in the form of a certificate after catching a pickpocket at the market.
sentences.ko: 루디는 시장에서 소매치기를 잡은 뒤 상장을 상으로 받았어요.

sentences.text: Medali emas itu menjadi ganjaran bagi kerja keras Rina selama setahun penuh.
sentences.en: The gold medal was the reward for Rina's hard work over an entire year.
sentences.ko: 그 금메달은 리나가 일 년 내내 노력한 대가였어요.

sentences.text: Polisi sedang menyelidiki pemungutan liar terhadap sopir truk di pelabuhan.
sentences.en: The police are investigating illegal levies on truck drivers at the port.
sentences.ko: 경찰은 항구에서 트럭 기사들에게 걷는 불법 징수를 조사하고 있어요.

sentences.text: Panitia mengadakan pemungutan suara untuk memilih desain kaus lomba tahun depan.
sentences.en: The organizers held a vote to choose next year's race shirt design.
sentences.ko: 주최 측은 내년 대회 티셔츠 디자인을 고르려고 투표를 했어요.

sentences.text: Kapolsek menolak intervensi dari orang berpengaruh dalam penyelidikan kasus itu.
sentences.en: The precinct chief rejected interference from influential people in the investigation of the case.
sentences.ko: 서장은 그 사건 수사에 영향력 있는 사람들이 끼어드는 것을 거절했어요.

sentences.text: Petugas medis melakukan intervensi cepat ketika seorang pelari tiba-tiba pingsan.
sentences.en: The medical staff stepped in quickly when a runner suddenly fainted.
sentences.ko: 한 주자가 갑자기 쓰러지자 의료진이 재빨리 조치했어요.
